scanner_incremental_model.cap_semantics: actionable candidates only; unchanged existing media excluded from the execute cap
scanner_incremental_model.next_batch_continuation: after a cap-limited batch executes, committed DynamicSourceItem rows become the next plan checkpoint; unexecuted private plan rows are never trusted without execute-time revalidation
scanner_incremental_model.previous_994_existing_explanation: The f1040fb plan selected known/root candidates and only discovered existing media after hash classification, so existing rows consumed the visible cap. The fixed model uses source-ledger metadata fast skip and actionable cap semantics so stable existing rows are diagnostics, not batch capacity.
scanner_incremental_model.starts_from_root_each_run: registered roots first use the DynamicSourceItem priority workset; filesystem enumeration is metadata fallback for files missing from the source ledger or changed since the ledger snapshot

cached_evidence_invalidates_on: relative_path_hash or source path identity change
hydration policy/profile/cap/manual E2E setting change for unexecuted plan
scanner_planner_model.cap_semantics: actionable importable or downstream-follow-up candidates; stable existing/duplicate/unchanged rows do not consume the user-visible execute cap
scanner_planner_model.durable_cursor_note: There is not yet a single global filesystem watermark. The implemented bounded alternative uses DynamicSourceItem as a durable source ledger plus priority workset and filesystem fallback for files not yet in the ledger.
hash_when: duplicate/existing-media verification when cached identity is not enough
scanner_planner_model.last_successful_scan_boundary: represented by DynamicSourceItem source identity/state, not a single operator-visible filesystem cursor

moved_deleted_modified_handling.deleted_or_missing: source_missing/path_missing stable item reason; not executable until visible again
moved_deleted_modified_handling.modified: metadata mismatch forces hash/revalidation and becomes changed/importable or duplicate/existing as appropriate
moved_deleted_modified_handling.moved: old ledger row becomes missing/stale and the new relative identity is discovered by filesystem fallback

scan_start_order: priority DynamicSourceItem rows for current actionable work
filesystem walk fallback after priority workset is exhausted or below cap
skip_hash_when: known stable DynamicSourceItem has unchanged root/relative identity/size/mtime and no downstream follow-up
stable unsupported/hidden/non-actionable historical rows are represented in diagnostics only
